name: Yugoslavia
facts: Seven states, from Slovenia to North Macedonia

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and red, with a large red five-pointed star edged in gold in the centre, overlapping all three stripes.
flag.symbolism: Blue, white and red are the Pan-Slavic colours, and the red star stood for socialism and the partisan struggle of the Second World War.

hook: Socialist Yugoslavia is a blue-white-red tricolour with one big gold-edged red star spanning all three stripes.
trivia: The same tricolour without the star was the flag of the earlier Kingdom of Yugoslavia, and of Serbia and Montenegro until 2006.
Yugoslavia was a founding member of the Non-Aligned Movement, whose first summit was held in Belgrade in 1961.
